UI_MFI_Opt_Position_TT:
Above hotbar: the HUD follows the hotbar, or the dashboard while driving.
Free: drag it anywhere with the mouse.
UI_MFI_Opt_KeepMaskOn: Keep the mask on while replacing the filter
UI_MFI_Opt_KeepMaskOn_TT:
Off: the character takes the mask off, replaces the filter and puts it back on, as when eating. There is no protection for the whole sequence.
On: the same motions play but the mask stays on. Protection is lost only while the new filter is being fitted, as in vanilla. The mask stays visible on the face.
The SCBA and the hazmat suit are always taken off before the oxygen tank is replaced, whatever this setting (vanilla does not allow it while worn).
UI_MFI_Opt_NotifyEmpty: Show "Filter used up" on the bar
UI_MFI_Opt_NotifyEmpty_TT: While the filter of the worn mask (the oxygen tank for the SCBA and the hazmat suit) is at 0, the empty bar shows "Filter used up" ("Oxygen tank empty") until you replace it.
UI_MFI_Opt_ShowDrainBlink: Blink the bar while the filter is being used
UI_MFI_Opt_ShowDrainBlink_TT:
While the filter is being used up, the first block of the bar blinks. The faster it drains, the faster it blinks.
The filter drains in containment zone gas, inside a toxic building and when there are 6 or more corpses nearby.
The SCBA and the hazmat suit blink only while they are switched on and holding off containment zone gas.
